primary_algorithm.implementation: independent implementation; no author implementation was copied

historical_records.correction: The preserved result used a 1+B*k beam-frontier planner. It was not Algorithm 1 and must not be interpreted as a PCTree-wide no-go. Before first publication, only machine-local worktree metadata in the historical JSON receipts was normalized to the branch-relative identifier; their result and evidence fields remain unchanged.

corrected_contract.candidate_pool: all local top-k children from every frontier parent are retained in the pool
corrected_contract.next_frontier: current-layer top-k by joint path score, stable ID tie break
corrected_contract.k1_selector: raw f32 strict-greater first-max before log-softmax; includes one-ULP, NaN, and infinity regression tests
corrected_contract.nonfinite_branching: k>1 rejects non-finite raw logits rather than inventing a source-unspecified top-k order
corrected_contract.leaf_policy: every retained root-to-leaf path is evaluated, including short leaves

dsv4_mini_pctree.cache_protocol: isolated per-run cache directory; machine-local path omitted
dsv4_mini_pctree.fixture_contract: When DSV4_MINI is explicitly set, unreadable fixture files propagate an error and missing required PCTree fields return MissingPctreeFixtureField; a targeted negative unit test pins the missing-field behavior.

dsv4_mini_dspark.cache_protocol: isolated per-run cache directory; machine-local path omitted

adverse_cached_observation.result: exit 0 after changing DSV4_MINI while reusing the normal Zig cache
adverse_cached_observation.interpretation: NOT EVIDENCE: the fixture-backed tests were served from cache rather than re-executed

missing_fixture_fail_closed_probe.required_protocol: Use an isolated cache directory, or another independently verified mechanism that forces execution, whenever DSV4_MINI changes.

fresh_result.failures: both PCTree DSV4_MINI tests failed when the explicitly supplied fixture was missing/unreadable

verification.known_build_warning: Both isolated-cache positive reruns retained the missing lib/llama/lib and pkg-config --list-all warning while Build Summary reported 9/9 steps succeeded.

lifecycle.unarmed_serial_verifier: fails before allocation or dsparkBeginWith and leaves the state fingerprint unchanged
lifecycle.positive_partial_accept: a target-continuation proposal with only its final token mutated accepts B-1 tokens and matches independent serial replay
lifecycle.full_accept: an unmodified target-continuation proposal accepts B tokens and matches independent serial replay

corrected_mini_measurement.interpretation: The corrected planner has no positive k>1 accepted-length result on this miniature fixture. This is not real-model quality, speed, packed-tree-verifier, or release evidence.

measurement_checkpoint.match_basis: dependency HEADs, porcelain status, and SHA-256 of all 23 modified or untracked file contents

dependencies.reproducibility_limit: The tested libmlx.dylib is pinned by its SHA-256 and byte size. MLX and MLX-C were tested from the disclosed dirty source states; reproduction of that binary from the clean base commits alone is not proven.

promotion_gate.decision: Do not build or publish a tree-shaped verifier from this evidence. Reconsider only with a separately preregistered real-model acceptance, lifecycle, quality, and speed evaluation.
